verdict.rationale: Cognee's own pricing page states plainly that it is open source and that the full memory engine can be run locally or self-hosted. That directly covers reading its source under an open license, and the local-run docs back up the self-hosting part. Missing for 10: the specific license is not named, there is no link to the source repository, and no independent or hands-on confirmation of the licensing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Cognee is open source. Run the full memory engine locally or on your own stack — free, forever.
you can also run the UI and all pipelines entirely on your own machine for free, with no account required
